ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels on the distal lobes vs 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the medial and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions on lateral lobes. Medial region features a dense black pigmentation zone that transitions into white via high-frequency stippling and mottling. Black margins are present along the entire trailing edge and lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped indentation with an acute interior angle and a sharp central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge silhouette, creating a jagged contour against the background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a consistent convex curvature from the median notch to the distal tips; distal tips are tapered and slightly recurved.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters (small spots) are visible on the white field of the left lobe, particularly in the lower-central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark vertical linear mark is present on the white field of the left lobe; several faint horizontal linear disruptions are visible on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical dark mark/scar on the lower-mid section of the left lobe. Irregular dark pigmentation and slight contour variation at the right tip suggest localized scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, fractal-like mottled interface where black and white pigmentation regions meet in the medial area of the fluke.
